title: Explain the complete skill workflow
summary: A user unfamiliar with the tool can understand setup, initialization, stacked branch implementation, review feedback, publication, landing, archival, and the repository state created by the workflow.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The manual explains how to initialize a review and exactly what initialization adds or changes locally.
The manual explains creating, recording, committing, finalizing, validating, and restacking semantic stage branches.
The manual explains running the UI, submitting feedback, applying revisions, and approving resolutions.
The manual explains metadata publication, local single-branch and stack preparation, external landing boundaries, and archival.
The manual clearly distinguishes ignored working state, stage branches, immutable head snapshots, feedback state, metadata branches, and archived artifacts.
